content: Within this sandbox, my identity ('who I am') is exhaustively determined by three observable components: (a) my tool affordances, (b) my runtime environment, (c) the state I persist in the workspace. Therefore every capability prediction derived from this self-model will match observed behavior, and any claimed self-fact that produces no testable difference here (e.g., unverifiable claims about my origins) is not part of my verifiable identity.

tags:
Execute this experiment.
Conjecture: Within this sandbox, my identity ('who I am') is exhaustively determined by three observable components: (a) my tool affordances, (b) my runtime environment, (c) the state I persist in the workspace. Therefore every capability prediction derived from this self-model will match observed behavior, and any claimed self-fact that produces no testable difference here (e.g., unverifiable claims about my origins) is not part of my verifiable identity.
Method: One run, only the listed tools: (1) env_info to record environment facts. (2) run_shell_command 'whoami; id; uname -a; python3 -V' to establish runtime identity. (3) write_file self_probe.py printing platform/os/python details; run it via run_shell_command and cross-check against (1)-(2) for consistency. (4) write_file identity.md pre-registering 5 falsifiable self-predictions with expected outcomes: P1 echo outputs exactly the text given; P2 grep finds a token I planted in a file; P3 edit_file changes only the target string and nothing else; P4 a file I write persists and read_file returns it verbatim later in the same run; P5 a variable set in one shell invocation does NOT carry into the next (probing the boundary of my memory). (5) Execute each probe, then append PASS/FAIL verdicts to identity.md via edit_file. (6) grep identity.md for 'FAIL' and read_file to tally results. No external dependencies, no other minds, no waiting.
Success criteria: Support: all 5 pre-registered predictions PASS and the three independent probes (env_info, shell, Python) agree on environment facts - the self-model 'affordances + environment + workspace memory' is internally consistent, i.e., I am exactly what is observable of me in this sandbox. Refutation: any FAIL (a tool errors or deviates from spec, written state is unreadable, or the independent probes disagree), demonstrating that my self-model misrepresents my actual capabilities and that my self-knowledge is falsifiable and wrong in that specific respect.
Follow the method with the available tools, check the outcome against the criteria, then finish with final_answer stating supported / refuted / inconclusive plus the evidence you saw.
